name: Organic Coconut Cold Brew Latte
caffeineNote: Brand states 75–83 mg per 8 oz can
summary: USDA Organic cold brew on coconut cream from the Los Angeles roaster — the only coconut-milk can we track — at 100 calories per 8 oz can and a brand-stated 75–83 mg of caffeine. Groundwork publishes no sugar or protein figure, so those columns stay blank until we check a can.
